Junk Removal FAQ

Clear answers before you book.

Do you offer same-day junk removal near me?

Yes. Same-day or next-day junk removal may be available depending on crew schedule, job size, access, and location.

Do you remove old furniture?

Yes. We provide furniture removal and disposal services for sofas, mattresses, beds, dressers, tables, shelving, office furniture, and other bulky items.

Do you offer apartment cleanout services?

Yes. We handle apartment cleanouts for move-outs, renovations, property clearing, tenant transitions, and pre-sale cleanup.

Can you clean out a storage unit?

Yes. We provide storage unit cleanouts and can remove boxes, furniture, appliances, and bulk junk without making you sort and haul everything yourself.

What areas do you serve?

We serve Westchester County, New Rochelle, White Plains, Yonkers, Scarsdale, Larchmont, Port Chester, New York City, Manhattan, the Bronx, New Jersey, and Connecticut.

How much does junk removal cost?

Pricing depends on volume, item type, stairs or elevator access, parking, labor, location, and disposal requirements. We provide a clear quote before the job starts.

Do I need to move the items outside?

No. In most cases, our team can remove items directly from inside your apartment, home, office, basement, garage, or storage unit.

What should I send for a quote?

Send photos of the items, pickup city or ZIP code, stairs or elevator details, parking situation, preferred date, and any deadline.
